description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' for logging purposes within an Android application. It provides static methods to log messages at different levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manages a chain of LogNode objects for flexible log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class that wraps around Android's native logging facilities, providing static methods to log messages at various levels and managing a chain of LogNode objects for log processing.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current head of the LogNode chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message to the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at the ASSERT level.
